raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "4.1.1"
  # dependencies
  lal_version: 8.0.0
  metaio_version: 8.4.0
  swig_version: 4.4.1

recipe:
  name: lalmetaio-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lalmetaio-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: 1741481ed708fb645d6544882a868c36433f8d5c86d83a90d2b5e6ad7477084c

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lalmetaio-c-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        - libmetaio >=${{ metaio_version }}

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: liblalmetaio
    inherit: lalmetaio-c-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblalmetaio*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lalmetaio*.pc
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalmetaio", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        - lalmetaio >=2.0.1
        - python-lalmetaio >=2.0.1
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - lalmetaio
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalmetaio
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL MetaIO library.

  - package:
      name: python-lalmetaio
    inherit:
      from: lalmetaio-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalmetaio", exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalmetaio", exact=True) }}
        - igwn-ligolw
        - python
        - python-lal >=${{ lal_version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalmetaio
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
        script:
          - python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LALMetaIO C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lalmetaio` package.

  - package:
      name: lalmetaio
    inherit:
      from: lalmetaio-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lalmetaio-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: build-bin
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - sed
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalmetaio", exact=True) }}
        - liblal >=${{ lal_version }}
        # needed by ./configure
        - numpy
        - python
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblalmetaio", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lalmetaio", exact=True) }}
        - python
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lalmetaio
          pip_check: false
      - script:
          # assert that the manuals don't contain errors
          - grep -q ModuleNotFoundError ${PREFIX}/share/man/man1/lalmetaio_*.1 && exit 1
          # check the executables
          - lalmetaio_version --verbose
          # the user environment script rewrites PATH, so check that it still works
          - bash -c '. "${PREFIX}/etc/lalmetaio-user-env.sh" && lalmetaio_version'
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the runtime tools.

about:
  summary: LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library
  description: |
    The LSC Algorithm MetaIO Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/LALSuite
